steps.what: Examine employee performance evidence and form a contextual evaluation
Discuss the employee evaluation, hear corrections and agree development actions

tasks.design: Keep evaluation and discussion with the supervisor using existing evidence in {TALENT} and {DOCS}. No generated rating or speculative paperwork saving is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Performance evidence needs context and a fair opportunity for correction.
tasks.enabler_now: Record access can support the review but cannot establish fair performance judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Incident counts may reflect deployment and opportunity rather than individual performance.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor tests evidence, hears the employee and gives specific developmental feedback.
tasks.altitude: Evaluation responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss a development plan supported by specific work examples

evidence.claim: Retaining contextual performance evaluation and discussion is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisory evaluation and discussion, not continuous employee surveillance, evidence collection by colleagues or HR administration.
The supervisor supplies observed examples and the employee supplies their account through existing practice; no free structured performance score is presumed.
Retain native records; no custom evaluation tool proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes; confirm applicable national employment and consultation requirements.
unknowns: Approved criteria, evidence access and employee correction procedure
research_questions: Which contextual factors must be discussed before an example supports a performance conclusion?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; evidence judgement and employee discussion retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Rate inmate behaviour and encourage acceptable conduct

steps.what: Rate inmate behavior against institutional criteria using contextual observations
Discuss low ratings and promote acceptable attitudes and behaviors with inmates

tasks.design: Retain human behaviour ratings in {OPS_SYSTEM} and direct discussion of expectations. No model produces ratings, inferred attitudes or automatic consequences.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same observed act can have different context and support needs.
tasks.enabler_now: Record tools do not remove contextual judgement or constructive interaction.
tasks.still_hard: A low rating can obscure health, communication or safeguarding concerns.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor hears the inmate, checks context and adapts the conversation respectfully.
tasks.altitude: Rating responsibility and interaction time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain an observed conduct concern requiring support
reach.learn: Welfare referral and limitations of behavioural ratings

evidence.claim: Keeping behaviour rating and constructive inmate discussion human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is contextual rating and conduct discussion, excluding unrelated incident response and general custody direction; roll-up assigns overlapping conversations once.
Supervisor s1 produces the rating and reasons with all effort counted; no structured intent, emotion or future-offending input is assumed.
Use existing records without a new scoring tool.
Zero upkeep because no workflow change is introduced; national custody rules need local confirmation.
unknowns: Local rating criteria, challenge rights and welfare referral process
research_questions: Which contextual or welfare concerns make a rating inappropriate without further review?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; contextual rating and direct conduct discussion retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain accountable employee evaluation and inmate behaviour judgement without a claimed capacity gain.
reach: Escalate welfare needs underlying conduct concerns
role.ambitious_version: A supervisor who explains decisions clearly and uses direct conversation to support better conduct and professional practice.
